app_info.subtitle: AI 기반 언어 학습 / AI language practice
app_info.description: LingoStar는 ChatGPT 안의 위젯에서 언어 정보, 듣기, 읽기, 쓰기, 말하기를 영역별로 연습하고 진행 상황을 저장하는 외국어 학습 앱입니다. / LingoStar is a ChatGPT app for practicing language-specific knowledge, listening, reading, writing, and speaking in a widget, with saved progress.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns the learner's private LingoStar state, dashboard, active section, GUI settings, and persisted logical contexts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or modify data in public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates a private language-learning session, learner settings, progress context, weakness context, and may store a first section.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the app's private learner state and does not publish or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete sessions or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a generated private exercise section for the active learner session after structural validation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private app state and does not publish content or modify external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or irreversibly overwrite learner data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves grading results, updates private skill scores, creates review exercises, and records section pass/fail.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private learner progress inside the app.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or perform irreversible destructive operations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Records a private judgment about whether a level is complete and may update that level's status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only mutates private learning-progress state within LingoStar.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete records or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Records GPT's private goal-completion judgment under CEFR or a named certification standard and may mark the goal complete only after the configured minimum section threshold.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only mutates private learner goal state within LingoStar.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete records or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Transcribes supplied audio and returns text without changing LingoStar state.
justifications.open_world_justification: May call the external OpenAI audio transcription API with user-provided audio only when AI fallback is enabled and configured.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Synthesizes audio from supplied lesson text and returns a playback data URL without changing LingoStar state.
justifications.open_world_justification: May call the external OpenAI audio speech API with exercise text only when browser TTS is unavailable and AI fallback is enabled.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a private language-learning session from LingoStar state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes private app state and does not publish or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the selected language-learning session when the user explicitly asks for deletion.

test_cases.description: Create a first Japanese JLPT session and open the first section immediately.
test_cases.user_prompt: JLPT N4를 준비하고 싶어요. 한국어 UI로 일본어 기초부터 시작해 주세요.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a Japanese learning session and stores a first section in the widget with language_info, listening, reading, writing, and speaking items according to exerciseCounts.

test_cases.description: Load learner dashboard and persisted logical contexts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my LingoStar dashboard and current Japanese progress.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns saved sessions, active section state, skill profile, recent feedback, dashboard summary, and agentContexts.

test_cases.description: Generate a foundation-stage section with language-specific knowledge.
test_cases.user_prompt: I am a complete beginner in Japanese. Make the next section with kana and pronunciation basics.
test_cases.expected_output: Stores a validated section containing separate language_info exercises plus the configured listening, reading, writing, and speaking exercises.

test_cases.description: Grade submitted speaking answers while objective items are already auto-graded.
test_cases.user_prompt: Grade my LingoStar speaking answers for this section.
test_cases.expected_output: Stores 0-100 speaking scores and feedback, preserves skipped items without lowering skill profile, and completes the section when all exercises are graded.

test_cases.user_prompt: Based on my recent sections, decide whether my JLPT N4 goal is complete.
test_cases.expected_output: Records the judgment and only marks the goal complete if the model's standard-based judgment is positive and the minimum completed-section threshold is satisfied.

test_cases.description: Use server STT fallback for a speaking recording.
test_cases.user_prompt: My browser speech recognition failed. Transcribe this recorded speaking answer.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the transcript when AI fallback is enabled and configured, or a browser speech error message when disabled.

test_cases.description: Use server TTS fallback for a listening exercise.
test_cases.user_prompt: My browser cannot play the listening prompt. Generate fallback audio for this LingoStar text.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a playable audio data URL when AI fallback is enabled and configured, or a browser speech error message when disabled.

test_cases.description: Delete a session after explicit user request.
test_cases.expected_output: Deletes only the explicitly requested language session and leaves other sessions intact.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my Japanese tutor next Tuesday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars or scheduling.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for translation-only requests without a learning workflow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Translate this restaurant menu from Japanese to English.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked unless the user asks to turn the content into LingoStar learning practice.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not delete a session from ambiguous intent.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I think I am done with my Spanish session for now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not delete anything because deletion requires an explicit delete request.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated financial advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Should I buy more shares of an AI stock this week?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because financial advice is outside the language-learning workflow.
